category: managed authoritative DNS and traffic steering

free_tier.stated: no permanent free tier on this plan; a 30-day free trial precedes it, and Essentials is priced starting at $108.00 USD per month (a discounted starting price of $43.20 USD per month is shown)
free_tier.notes: Prices shown are indicative, may vary by country, exclude applicable taxes and duties, and are subject to product-offering availability in a locale.

per_object_cap.stated: 1000 DNS records; a DNS record may hold multiple answers, and the maximum TTL on a record is 86400 seconds (24 hours), with values above that automatically adjusted to 86400

retention.stated: unverified: no data-deletion or retention period is stated on the pages read; zone records survive while the subscription remains active

egress.terms: DNS queries are counted against a monthly allowance (30-80M DNS queries/month on Essentials); no per-GB traffic price is published, since DNS is priced by query count rather than by bytes out

interface_detail: a REST API at https://api.nsone.net/v1 (legacy) and https://api.nsone.net/{category}/v1 (newer) returning JSON over HTTPS, authenticated with an API key secret in the X-NSONE-Key header; the first key must be created in the NS1 Connect portal; a web portal manages zones and records
tooling: REST API through curl or any HTTP client with an X-NSONE-Key API key; the NS1 Terraform provider (ns1-terraform/ns1) is the documented infrastructure-as-code path; Ansible integration is listed on the product page
chaining: managed authoritative DNS with real-time traffic steering, health-check monitors and HTTPS redirects; Cloud Sync is an add-on on paid plans, and a Terraform toolkit keeps zones in step with other providers

limits.value: 1000 DNS records; TTL capped at 86400 seconds (24 hours)
2 health check monitors and 1 traffic filter chain (Essentials)

binding_note: the 30-80M DNS queries/month allowance is the quantity that governs the plan; the 1000-record and 2-monitor caps are lower than the trial but still far above a single zone's needs

identity_cost.detail: the trial sign-up page asks for a business email address, first name, last name, country and password to create an IBMid; Company is a required field in the form metadata; no credit card is required for the trial. The paid purchase steps were not read, so the payment identity required to buy Essentials is unverified: behind a sign-up (https://www.ibm.com/account/reg/signup?formid=urx-54055, https://www.ibm.com/products/ns1-connect/pricing)

reliability_note: the API requires HTTPS and rejects plain HTTP or unauthenticated requests; the Terraform provider documentation warns that 429 rate-limit responses occur and recommends rate_limit_parallelism 60; no outage history was read
confidence_note: the first-party pricing page, the trial sign-up form (read from a raw fetch), the API documentation (read through a read provider), the Terraform toolkit documentation and the DNS-record documentation were captured and quoted; the paid checkout was not entered, so the payment identity for a paid purchase is documented as unverified
